svg.text: S T E P H E N K I N G / I T
The town, the Barrens and the rural approaches
T H E B A R R E N S
Four sheets form one map. Sheet 2 expands the town centre; sheets
3 and 4 reveal the Barrens and the Losers' ground. Smaller downtown
All coordinates are reconstructed. A names a relationship stated in the text;
it does not certify an exact position.
Contour strokes show conceptual relief only. Unlabelled buildings, minor
streets and parcel shapes are illustrative. No numerical elevations are implied.
Source of inspiration: Stephen King, IT (1986). Chapter references and
reconstruction decisions are in the map database. The original research notes
are retained as a baseline reference.
A2 / 594 x 420 mm / Print at 100% for stated scale
Composite map: former sites retained. Surface geography only. Map geometry and relief are inferred; no screen adaptation geography used.
